findings.evidence: The declarations occur at lines 205 and 215. For closed `C ⊆ Fin n → α`, `ofFn ⁻¹' (ofFn '' C)` is the finite union of the images of `C` under coordinate permutations, hence closed; the analogous finite union of permutation graphs is closed when `α` is Hausdorff.
findings.fix: Prove `isClosedMap_ofFn` in `Topology/Sym.lean` using the finite permutation description of each fiber, then derive `T2Space (Sym α n)` under `[T2Space α]`; use these general results here.
findings.issue: `isClosedMap_ofFn` and `instT2Space` (line 215) unnecessarily require a proper algebraically closed normed field; the quotient by permutations is closed for any topological `α`, and preserves Hausdorffness when `[T2Space α]`.

summary: The earlier hypothesis issues are fixed, but two topological corollaries remain restricted to the coefficient-chart setting despite having natural general statements.
